title: Bali
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, as in Taanit 18a, where he spoke in his name, and Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba said to him, “I will explain it to you” (Rashi explains: Bali is a sage’s name). In Berakhot 25b: “Bali said that Rabbi Yaakov, the son of Shmuel’s daughter, said.” In Shabbat 17b: “Bali said that Avimi Sanvata’ah said”; Avodah Zarah 36a reads Avimi Nota’ah.

notes.text: תלמדו is read as תלמידו, “his student.”
